source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-2

procedures.title: Electrical service precautions and fusible link replacement
steps: Disconnect the battery before any electrical work other than changing a bulb or fuse.
When replacing a fusible link, use wire of the same gauge with special hypalon insulation.
notes: Fusible links protect circuits that are not normally fused, such as ignition; each link is four wire gauges smaller than the cable it guards.
The gauge is marked on the link insulation because the thick insulation makes the link look heavier than it is.
Fiber optic lamp monitoring is standard on the 1968 Corvette; the lenses glow when exterior lights are on. Backup and marker lamps are not monitored.
Vacuum-operated headlamp covers are standard on the 1968 Corvette.
